## Problem

Explain the user problem and its effect.

## Change

Describe the resulting behavior and any compatibility effect.

## Evidence

List the relevant checks and their results.
Include failure cases, target coverage, and any remaining limit.

## Review notes

Identify changes to formats, trust boundaries, specifications, proofs, or published claims.
Record the complete history reviewed, affected earlier decisions, intentional departures, and any unavailable history.
Explain why added structure is necessary and identify any superseded material removed.
